title: Free Donuts, Go Go Go
trend: TikTok 'Go, Go, Go' (lip-syncs to an urgent 'go' audio for moments that demand immediate action; New Engen TikTok list, updated Nov 16 2026, US) + free-food office emails before the holidays — on new intern Kevin's first day, Big Lou from IT teaches him the free-food sprint rules while office manager Marjorie rolls her eyes; a 'free donuts' email sends everyone to the break room, where the donut box holds only three donuts; twist: the email was Kevin's text to his mom sent reply-all to the whole building, so four hundred people, the bike messenger and the boss from the ninth floor are coming
youtube_title: The email said free donuts. The whole office ran. The new guy sent it 🍩
description:
It is Kevin's first day, and Big Lou has one rule: when the email says free food, you go. Then the email comes. The donut box has three donuts and some bad news about who sent it.

#cartoon #animation #funny #office #shorts
tiktok_caption: the email said free donuts. the whole office ran 🍩 #cartoon #animation #funny #office

lines.text: New guy. Rule number one. When the email says free food, you go.
Go where?
Go, go, go. Ninety seconds. After that it is crumbs and regret.
Lou, it is his first day. Let him find the bathroom.
The bathroom will be there tomorrow. The donuts will not.
Has this happened before?
Last March. Free pizza. Gary from sales went over the copy machine.
Not around it. Over it.
Is Gary okay?
Gary is a legend now. He works in accounting.
Rule two. No socks on the carpet. Too much speed.
Rule three. Elevators are for amateurs. Take the stairs.
We are on the first floor.
Then go up and come back down. For training.
What if I get there and it is gone?
You smile. You say congratulations. And you remember their face.
Wait. New email. Free donuts. Break room.
Go, go, go!
Which way is the break room?
Follow Lou. Follow the wind.
Hello. I am the donut box. Please form a line.
First! I touched the box. I touched it first.
I made it. I think I lost a shoe.
You lost both shoes. They are in the hallway making friends.
I must be honest. I hold three donuts.
Three? For the whole floor?
One sprinkle. One jelly. And one plain one that nobody loves.
I love the plain one.
That is beautiful, ma'am. He has been waiting since seven.
The sprinkle one is mine. Ten years.
Can I have the jelly? I ran very hard.
The jelly is very full. Hold him like a baby bird.
Wait. I hear footsteps. The second floor is coming.
Was it? Let me check my lid.
Who sent it, box? Who sent the email?
Sent by Kevin. Reply all. The whole building.
Kevin.
No. No, no, no. I was texting my mom.
Read it, box. Read the whole thing.
Mom, free donuts at work. I love this job. Bring me a coat.
You sent your mom a message through four hundred people.
The third floor is here. They brought plates.
And the bike messenger. He is still on the bike.
And now the big boss. From the ninth floor.
What do we do?
We do what we trained for, Kevin.
The stairs?
The stairs.
Go, go, go!
They are gone. Just me and the ninth floor.
I stayed. Plain one, please.
Finally. Somebody who sees me.
From the stairwell, Kevin. Rule four. Never reply all.
Why was that not rule one?
Rule one is go. Rule one is always go.
Welcome to the team, Kevin.
Do I get my shoes back?
Your shoes joined the second floor. They are happy.
